sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Construct was knocked into CHO cells for expression; the clip reports construct creation and knock-in but does not detail a functional enzymatic assay in the cited passage — NOT MEASURED beyond expression.
sites.rationale: HS3ST2 is a type II TM Golgi sulfotransferase with its catalytic C-terminal domain (residues 38–367) in the Golgi lumen (extracellular face). The C-terminus at residue 367 (E) is 330 residues from the TM boundary (residue 37), well clear of any TM constraint. The paper explicitly describes a C-terminal V5/S-tag on full-length HS3ST2 knocked into CHO cells; since the C-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus, insert_after_residue=367 is topology-derived with no ambiguity. Python confirms seq[366]='E'. Full-length human HS3ST2 with a C-terminal V5-tag (or S-tag) was constructed by PCR and knocked into CHO cells via the EPB69 donor plasmid. HS3ST2 is a type II transmembrane protein; its C-terminus (residue 367, E) lies in the extracellular/Golgi-luminal domain (residues 38–367). The paper names 'C-terminal' but no specific residue; with a single extracellular terminus the junction is unambiguous.

sources.claim: Full complementary DNAs of coding regions of the human HS3STs (Horizon Discovery and Harvard PlasmID Database) were used, a C-terminal S-tag or V5-tag was linked to HS3STs by polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and constructs were further cloned into the EPB69 donor plasmid.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) was provided. It supports exactly one site: a C-terminal tag on full-length HS3ST2 expressed in CHO cells. The N-terminus (residues 1–19) is intracellular and the TM spans residues 20–37, so no extracellular N-terminal site exists. No internal loop insertions are supported by the ledger. The paper does not name a specific residue number for the C-terminal junction; the position is derived from the fact that residue 367 is the sole extracellular terminus. No functional enzymatic assay result is reported in the clip, so validation_level is 'detected_only'.
